cases.task: Extend JMESPath unknown function diagnostics with 'did you mean' suggestions and an evaluation option. In jmespath.exceptions, update UnknownFunctionError to accept (function_name, similar=None), storing self.function_name and self.similar, and formatting str as 'Unknown function: <name>(), did you mean: <similar>()?' when similar is provided, or 'Unknown function: <name>()' when similar is None. In jmespath.functions.Functions.call_function, accept an optional suggest=True parameter; when function_name is not in FUNCTION_TABLE, use difflib.get_close_matches with cutoff 0.6 to find the closest match from registered functions and pass it as similar to UnknownFunctionError when suggest is True. In jmespath.visitor.Options, add suggest_functions=True (defaulting to True) and pass suggest=self._options.suggest_functions from TreeInterpreter.visit_function_expression to call_function. Preserve existing function arity and type checks, and keep existing built-in functions unchanged. Add regression test methods to TestFunctions in tests/test_functions.py and run that file.
